title: Preview 2 game feedback
author: vispar9999
selftext:
# Questions & Help — Maze Escape Preview 2

I’m developing my first game, **Maze Escape**, a 2D cave/maze game built with Python.

**Preview 2 is now available**, and I’ve been working on improving the game based on what I learned from the first version. The game currently includes multiple levels, enemies, bombs, crystals, breakable walls, shops, new abilities, and different challenges as you progress.

For development, I use **Python, Pygame, Aseprite, and generative AI**. Aseprite helps me create and edit pixel-art assets, while AI helps me experiment with ideas, assets, debugging, and parts of the development process.

I’m still learning game development, so feedback would really help me improve Preview 2 and future updates.

What should I focus on most?

• Level design  
• Visuals / animations  
• Difficulty balancing  
• Enemy AI  
• Bombs and abilities  
• Controls  
• Overall gameplay

🎮 **Play Preview 2:**  
[https://visper99.itch.io/maze-escape](https://visper99.itch.io/maze-escape)

Thanks to anyone who tries it and shares feedback!      FYI (If you want to try the game on web the loading will take 25-45 seconds before the game starts which takes a while my bad.
